findings: ours-branch ties or beats Solid on 12/14 docs; wins prose (their reflow 0.8, word corruption) and lists (their numbering 0.914)

Solid's lead is wrap_hard+two_column only; their wrap_hard reflow is real (6 paras, 0 w:br) but text pays: recall 0.902 precision 0.821 with mid-word breakage: meas-urement, pro-cedure, incon-sistent, acknow-ledgement
Word reflow is the only engine with clean text AND rewrap on wrap_hard (0.862) but drops heading styles everywhere
ours-live (no enhance) is behind Word reflow on all 14 docs; season passes are worth +0.175 mean
